[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Chat markdown and published prompt archive entries store exactly [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and no code anywhere in sase or sase-core knows the sase-e6 format [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exists.[/#D7D7AF]
